podcast.body: This song, released in 1979, was a significant success for The Skids, reaching the top 10 on the UK singles chart. It was described as "New Way Celtic rock." "This is called Into the Valley. Call this New Way Celtic rock. The Skids from 1979 and Into the Valley."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
